description:
Why this choice is correct: AiaError::IoFailure (pkix-aia/src/lib.rs:198-204) carries 'kind: std::io::ErrorKind' plus 'message: String' rather than embedding std::io::Error directly. The decomposition is a deliberate response to AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6: result types MUST derive Clone + Debug + PartialEq + Eq + Send + Sync, and SHOULD support serde behind a feature flag. std::io::Error provides NONE of: Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize. Embedding it would block the entire cache-friendliness invariant.

The rustdoc at lines 188-195 captures the rationale clearly. The os_error() numeric code is dropped — this is a real information loss, but the alternative (embed std::io::Error, lose Clone+Eq+Serialize) is worse for the workspace's prevalidation/cache-replay use case.

A future contributor might suggest 'just embed std::io::Error with #[serde(skip)] and conditional Clone'. Reject: the partial workarounds make the invariant fragile and surprise downstream tooling that depends on the full set of derives. Decomposition is the right call.
title: Decision: AiaError carries decomposed { kind, message } not std::io::Error
